invariants.ownership_isolation: A memory must never be returned to a user who does not own it.
invariants.current_state_context_eligibility: A current-state context must not include a deleted, pending, failed, expired, or superseded memory.
invariants.no_forced_nearest_match: When no M2-eligible candidate meets the approved relevance threshold, retrieval must return a successful empty no_relevant_memory result rather than force the nearest candidate into context.
invariants.explicit_supersession_is_atomic: Only an explicit user correction to an owner-scoped active indexed matching target may atomically make a pending replacement current and write both relationship directions; inferred or ambiguous input must not mutate supersession relationships.
invariants.historical_retrieval_is_explicit_and_rea: Only explicit historical intent may admit authorized non-deleted superseded memories; historical retrieval must not reactivate or otherwise mutate lifecycle or relationship state.
invariants.trusted_clock_expiration_is_atomic: Current retrieval uses one validated trusted UTC instant; eligible memories expire atomically at valid_until before search, while persisted expired memories remain excluded from current retrieval and may be read only through explicit authorized history.
invariants.forgetting_is_global_and_nonreactivating: After an authorized forget request is accepted, that memory must be unavailable through every retrieval path, and forgetting a newer memory must not reactivate an older superseded memory.
invariants.recovery_uses_sqlite_authority: Recovery must rebuild and verify derived FAISS state only from fully audited SQLite authority; unsafe identity, integrity, or durable-publication state must prevent service exposure.
invariants.observability_is_private_and_noninterfer: Local events must contain only strictly validated allowlisted decision metadata and keyed user references, never private payloads or free-form errors; ordinary telemetry failures must not repeat primary work, alter results or exceptions, change readiness or service exposure, or add lifecycle-clock reads.
invariants.fixed_workload_evaluation_is_truthful_an: Evaluation must preserve the six original fixture and baseline bytes and frozen retrieval settings, report real case-specific unweighted PASS/PARTIAL/FAIL evidence without downgrading or averaging away hard safety failures, and claim only a pre-production reference implementation.
